verdict.rationale: GitBook documents an embedded AI Assistant for readers of published sites ([gitbook-docs-16], [gitbook-docs-31]) that can be added to docs to give users contextual answers ([gitbook-docs-39]). AI insights confirms the assistant answers visitor questions using your own content ([gitbook-docs-37]), and AI search is listed as a plan feature ([gitbook-docs-9]). missing for 10: explicit evidence that answers include citations or links into the source pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality.
